summary: Verified one-click demo login fix. All 3 demo buttons on /login now trigger POST /api/auth/login and redirect by role. Backend pytest (test_login_roles.py) 4/4 passed. Playwright e2e: Super Admin -> /super-admin, Admin/PIC -> /admin, Mahasiswa -> /dashboard; each returns 200 with correct role, token in body, and httpOnly access_token cookie. During in-flight login all demo buttons are disabled (prevents double-click). No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390. No console/page errors. Google OAuth not exercised.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx loginWithDemoAccount uses the same AuthContext.login() as the manual form -> no bypass endpoint; matches requirement.
All three demo buttons share the same loading state (disabled={loading}) which correctly prevents concurrent clicks.
Demo credentials are read from REACT_APP_DEMO_* env vars; ensure these stay in sync with backend seed if secrets rotate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo one-click login is fully working. Data-testids: demo-account-super-admin-button, demo-account-admin-button, demo-account-student-button. All hit POST /api/auth/login and navigate via dashboardPath(role). Cookie access_token is httpOnly.
rca of the issue: Previous behavior only showed a toast because handler didn't actually call login/navigate; current Login.jsx loginWithDemoAccount calls AuthContext.login(email, password) then navigate(dashboardPath(user.role)) — verified live end-to-end.
